onboarding.title: Bring DSH to the desktop
onboarding.lead: The desktop app first checks for an existing dsh CLI. After confirmation, DSH Chat opens in a dedicated desktop WebView; your DSH Home, credentials, and plugins remain managed by DSH.
advanced.title: DSH runtime and desktop settings
advanced.summary: Runtime settings are passed to dsh web; desktop settings apply only to this app. Changes do not require restarting the desktop app.
config.runtime_hint: These are passed to the single dsh web subprocess. Settings open as a modal over Chat without hiding it. Closing this page returns to Chat; if you changed workspace, Home, or CLI, click “Reopen Chat” to restart dsh web. No desktop app restart needed.
config.desktop_hint: Applies only to the desktop app and does not change DSH’s own settings.yaml. Update checks are configured in the runtime console.
field.executable_hint: If auto-detection fails, choose an installed dsh, dsh.cmd, or absolute path; the desktop app will not download the CLI.
field.home_hint: Passed only as DSH_HOME to the subprocess; nothing is copied, migrated, or written as a second config.
field.workspace_hint: Working directory when starting DSH Chat; defaults to the system user directory and can be a project folder. The listen port is assigned by dsh web and parsed from its output.
field.desktop_dir_hint: Fixed at DSH_HOME/.deepseek-harness-desktop for desktop use only; not used as Chat workspace.
field.confirm_quit: Ask me before quitting while a task is running
field.confirm_quit_hint: Window close and quit shortcuts will confirm first. Turn this off to always quit immediately.
field.confirm_quit_hint_dashboard: Window close and ⌘Q / Ctrl+Q will confirm first. Turn off to always quit immediately.
field.language_hint: Follow the system language, or pick a fixed language. Saved in desktop-prefs.json.
install.title: No dsh found yet?
install.body: Install the official CLI in a terminal first, then return here and click “Recheck CLI”. Commands are shown only; the desktop app does not run them.
bridge.title: Optional: install desktop management bridge plugin
bridge.summary: Lets DSH Chat control the desktop app; Chat still works without it.
bridge.hint: After install, DSH Chat “Settings → Plugins → Desktop management” offers status, start, stop, restart, and open desktop settings.
bridge.status_found: Found in-repo plugin directory; the install command only adds it to the web profile.
bridge.status_missing: Plugin directory not found; choose plugins/deepseek-harness-desktop-bridge from the project.

steps.title: Three steps to finish setup
steps.bridge_copy: Let DSH settings manage the desktop app
steps.chat_copy: Start working in the desktop WebView
steps.privacy: The desktop app only manages the one DSH process it starts. Credentials are never shown on the onboarding page, in logs, or in bridge responses.
dashboard.title: DSH is ready
dashboard.lead: Manage launch options here; chat content and DSH settings stay in the official DSH Web UI.
dashboard.update_hint: When a new version is found, you decide whether to install.
dashboard.auto_check: Automatically check for updates daily after a successful start
dashboard.bridge_hint: In DSH Chat open “Settings → Plugins → Desktop management” to control the desktop app in the same WebView.
dashboard.footer: DSH Chat opens in a dedicated desktop WebView and never jumps to the system default browser.
discard.title: Settings changed
discard.body: Discard these changes and return to Chat? Unsaved paths will not be applied to dsh web.
update.idle_on: Checks start about 1 hour after launch, then roughly once a day; you choose whether to install new versions.
update.idle_off: Periodic checks are off. Check manually when needed; you choose whether to install.
